predecessor: O5: all 729 supplied O4 predictive memory belief states distinct; exact 10-bit lower bound already attained by symbolic peer; no learned-compression headroom in unary vocabulary.
new_mechanism: Train binary causal operators online from authenticated-in-principle interventions using four GF(2) algebraic-normal-form coefficients (bias, A, B, A*B). Include nonlinear interaction absent from O4. The learner must abstain on predictions not invariant across every coefficient vector consistent with purchased public evidence.

public_study_design.operator_family: ALL 16 binary Boolean functions, not restricted to supplied four unary maps
public_study_design.relation: two input entity ports A,B with hidden swap; consider 32 physical (law,port-map) hypotheses
public_study_design.evidence: query-blind stream of intervention records labeled by PUBLIC A,B values and output; attested/independent flags synthetic only, not proof of origin
public_study_design.future_queries: four possible do(A=x,B=y) interventions; no future query used during fitting
public_study_design.control: separately implemented equally informed full-16-truth-table symbolic version-space; same evidence; both abstain until every consistent function agrees on a future query
public_study_design.scope: source-free complete finite proof/representation engineering, no independent TRAIN/DEV/science
public_study_design.enumeration: all 16 truths x 16 subsets of four intervention cells x 4 future do queries = 1024 learner-control predictions; independently enumerate all 81 partial evidence ternary states; test all 32 physical law/swap descriptions for observational indistinguishability
public_study_design.identifiability_hypothesis: Every observable binary function has two distinct physical explanations, (law,identity) and (port-swapped-law,swap); under unrestricted 16-law family no output-only intervention schedule can identify physical input-port mapping without an exogenous relational anchor.
public_study_design.ablation: Removing A*B term must fail to represent exactly eight non-affine binary Boolean rules; certifier must never guess them. Restricted affine learner must abstain or reject incompatible public evidence.
public_study_design.strong_control: Full symbolic truth-table lattice; baseline correctness retained; no novelty claim from parity
public_study_design.bounds: 4-bit ANF is information-theoretically minimal for 16 unrestricted observable Boolean laws; physical binding identity requires separate anchor; no resource improvement claim

acceptance.final_integration_regression: Only if eligible for acceptance, never just for mathematical prototype.
acceptance.operator_vocab_not_supplied_to_learner_a: Only publicly declared representable class of all 16 possible binary Boolean laws; no true coefficient or future truth may be read before evidence.

search_engine_policy: Dream-RSI/ThetaEvolve/Pareto proposals only; no search or tuning on consumed scientific DEV, no new controller or paid inference. Next independent experiment requires original external source birth and strong trained recurrent/relational controls.
